qualifier: vocal, auditory and sensory-gating behaviors
name: Locomotor, sensorimotor and social vocal behavior
rationale: Members are organismal behaviors (locomotion, grooming, reflexes, touch and proprioception, vocal and observational learning, prepulse inhibition) plus development of behavior-relevant brain regions; unlike the confusables (MECP2/Rett regulation, glycinergic transmission, voluntary movement, neural RNA-binding module) the theme carries the sensory-gating, vocal and social behavior terms.

qualifier: early B and T precursor stages with V(D)J recombination
name: Early B and T lymphocyte development and V(D)J recombination
rationale: Members cover B lineage commitment, pre-B differentiation, V(D)J recombination, double-positive thymocytes and T cell differentiation, whereas the confusables center on mature B cell activation, BCR/TCR signaling and costimulation.

qualifier: control of protein cell-surface localization
name: Receptor internalization, recycling and cell-surface localization control
rationale: Members regulate clathrin cargo recognition, GPCR/receptor internalization, endocytic recycling and protein levels at the cell surface, whereas the confusables add postsynaptic neurotransmitter receptor trafficking, Rab/ARF signaling and Golgi/secretory transport.

qualifier: factor XII and plasma kallikrein, hereditary angioedema
name: Factor XII–kallikrein contact activation and hereditary angioedema
rationale: All members concern factor XII/plasma kallikrein contact activation (intrinsic coagulation, C1-inhibitor and FXII angioedema, amyloid-triggered FXII activation), unlike confusables on VWF, extrinsic/common coagulation and fibrinolysis.

qualifier: cadherin, PTEN, PD-L1 and ALK–STAT3 targets
name: Transcriptional repression of cadherin, PTEN and PD-L1 genes
rationale: Members are negative regulation of transcription and DNA binding plus specific regulation of CDH1, CDH11, PTEN, PD-L1 and TGFBR3 transcription and ALK–STAT3 nuclear events, while confusables center on RUNX3, PAX3 targets or mesenchymal TGF-beta/Wnt programs.

qualifier: proliferation, migration, fusion and differentiation control
name: Myoblast proliferation, migration, fusion and differentiation control
rationale: Members regulate myoblast fate, proliferation, migration, fusion and myotube differentiation, whereas confusables emphasize satellite cell maintenance/activation, muscle organ development and fiber differentiation.

qualifier: intraflagellar transport and centriole/centrosome duplication control
name: Intraflagellar transport and cilium assembly–disassembly control
rationale: Members cover intraflagellar anterograde/retrograde transport, basal body docking, transition zone, positive and negative control of cilium assembly and centriole elongation; confusables instead emphasize ciliary membrane cargo targeting, centrosome positioning or motile cilia.

core: Osteoclast and macrophage fusion and proliferation
qualifier: M-CSF and DAP12 signaling, bone resorption
name: M-CSF–driven osteoclast and macrophage fusion and bone resorption
rationale: Members combine CSF1 receptor and DAP12 signaling with macrophage/osteoclast fusion, proliferation, osteoclast differentiation and bone resorption, unlike confusables on GM-CSF myeloid/dendritic differentiation or microglia.

qualifier: glycerol and urea, not vasopressin-renal
name: Aquaporin-mediated water, glycerol and urea transport
rationale: Members are aquaporin/aquaglyceroporin passage of water, glycerol, urea and amides, whereas confusables concern vasopressin-regulated renal water reabsorption or fatty acid/thermogenesis.

qualifier: GPIb-IX-V and collagen adhesion
name: Platelet adhesion via GPIb-IX-V and aggregation control
rationale: Members cover platelet adhesion to collagen, GPIb-IX-V signaling and positive/negative regulation of aggregation, whereas confusables cover VWF variants, GPVI cascade, or soluble agonist receptors and degranulation.

qualifier: hair follicle and nail
name: Hair follicle, nail and ectodermal appendage morphogenesis
rationale: Members concern hair follicle placode, maturation and anagen, nail development, epidermal morphogenesis and ectodermal differentiation, unlike confusables on tooth development or interfollicular keratinocyte differentiation.

qualifier: TLR3/7/8/9 to IRF3/IRF7, herpes encephalitis defects
name: Endosomal TLR signaling to IRF3/IRF7 and herpes encephalitis defects
rationale: Members cover TLR3 and TLR7/8/9 signaling through IRAK/TRAF6/TBK1 to IRF3/IRF7 and IKK, endosomal TLR trafficking and UNC93B1/TLR3/TRIF/TRAF3 herpes simplex encephalitis deficiencies, unlike confusables on TRIF-mediated cell death, TLR4 or cytosolic nucleic acid sensing.

qualifier: sensing, NHEJ and repair pathway choice
name: Double-strand break sensing, NHEJ and repair pathway choice
rationale: Members cover DSB sensing and ATM signaling, classical/alternative NHEJ, regulation of HR versus NHEJ and BRCA1/BARD1/BRCA2 defects, whereas confusables cover PARP ADP-ribosylation or HR mechanics such as resection and strand invasion.

qualifier: E2F–RB G1/S transcription and G2/M checkpoints
name: Cell cycle control by E2F–RB and G2/M checkpoints
rationale: Members span E2F/RB/DREAM G1/S transcription, cyclin-CDK regulation and G2/M checkpoint and transition events, whereas confusables emphasize DNA replication initiation or proliferation modules in stimulated T cells.

qualifier: skin morphogenesis and sebaceous gland development
name: Skin morphogenesis, keratinocyte differentiation and barrier formation
rationale: Members cover skin and epidermis morphogenesis, keratinocyte development, cornified envelope assembly, ABCA12 ichthyosis and barrier establishment, while confusables focus on keratinocyte proliferation control, desmosome/hemidesmosome adhesion or lipoxygenase lipid synthesis.

qualifier: cohesin loading, establishment and resolution
name: Cohesin-mediated sister chromatid cohesion and its resolution
rationale: All members concern cohesin loading, establishment, maintenance and resolution of sister chromatid cohesion (plus cohesin chromatin looping), unlike confusables on spindle assembly, checkpoints and chromosome condensation.

qualifier: RIT/RIN to p38 and oncogenic MAP2K
name: Ras-family GTPase signaling via RIT/RIN and MAP2K
rationale: Members are positive regulation of Ras signaling, RIT/RIN signaling to p38 and MAP2K mutant signaling, unlike confusables on RAS GAPs/NF1, MRAS–RAF activation or NTRK3 signaling.

qualifier: holoenzyme assembly and recruitment to telomeres
name: Telomerase assembly, telomere recruitment and telomere extension
rationale: Members concern telomerase holoenzyme assembly, its localization to telomeres and telomere extension, unlike confusables on telomere capping/protection, C-strand synthesis or Cajal body RNA trafficking.

core: Amino acid neurotransmitter transport and metabolism
qualifier: glutamate, GABA and glycine
name: Glutamate, GABA and glycine neurotransmitter transport and metabolism
rationale: Members cover uptake, vesicular loading, synthesis and degradation of glutamate, aspartate, GABA, glycine and serine with their SLC transporter diseases, whereas confusables concern cholinergic or monoaminergic transmission.

qualifier: APC/C control, chromatid separation, spindle and cytokinesis
name: APC/C-controlled anaphase, chromatid separation, spindle and cytokinesis
rationale: Members span APC/C regulation and substrate degradation, sister chromatid cohesion and separation, spindle checkpoint and assembly, PLK1/AURKA and cytokinesis; confusables cover only one side (cohesion/spindle, condensation/nuclear envelope, or G1/S–G2/M control).

qualifier: FGFR1c–Klotho and parathyroid hormone
name: FGFR1c–Klotho and PTH phosphate signaling in bone mineralization
rationale: Members are FGFR1c–Klotho (FGF23 receptor) activation and FGFR-MAPK signaling, responses to phosphate and parathyroid hormone, and positive bone mineralization, whereas confusables concern phosphate transporters and their diseases.

qualifier: by FGF23–Klotho, PTH and phosphate
name: Bone mineralization control by Klotho–FGFR, PTH and phosphate
rationale: Members are positive and negative regulation of bone mineralization during bone maturation together with FGFR1c–Klotho, parathyroid hormone and phosphate responses, unlike confusables on tooth mineralization or vitamin D metabolism.

qualifier: aortic wall development
name: Collagen and elastic fiber assembly in aortic development
rationale: Members cover collagen biosynthesis and crosslinking, elastic fiber assembly and turnover and ECM assembly together with aorta smooth muscle morphogenesis, unlike confusables on basement membrane, MMP collagen degradation or generic ECM modules.

qualifier: leucine and valine pathway inborn errors
name: Leucine and valine catabolism and its organic acidurias
rationale: Members are leucine and valine catabolism and their enzyme deficiencies (isovaleric acidemia, MCC, 3-methylglutaconic aciduria, HIBCH, ECHS1, beta-ketothiolase), unlike confusables on biotin, isoleucine or short-chain fatty acid metabolism.

qualifier: somitogenesis, neural plate and hindbrain segmentation
name: Somitogenesis, neural plate and hindbrain segmental patterning
rationale: Members cover somite specification and segmentation, neural plate and border formation, rhombomere/HOX hindbrain patterning and boundary formation, unlike confusables on axial mesoderm/ventral neural tube or Hox cluster expression modules.
